Revalidated this usage and synchronize the expired OSV exception with cargo audit/deny. Consumers using private-key operations require separate assessment; not a general safety certification.

Reviewed newer source introduces a different custom-secret wrapper safety flaw, so do not replace one advisory with newly identified unsafe code. Exact temporary hold, not a claim the general crate API is sound.
